options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **AI usage/activity figures on this dashboard come from Claude Code OTel** and are scoped through the connection-to-project mapping and the Project/Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Activity totals use `canonical_activity` rows; model-usage totals come from `ai_model_usages`. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping, so mixing them in made the “Company-wide” figures uncomparable to the project-scoped delivery panels below.
- **Active Hours** is queried directly from Claude Code's OTel telemetry, not the shared `ai_activities` table — session duration isn't rolled up into the domain layer for any provider.
- **Commits/code churn in closed, unmerged PRs** require at least one closed PR and no merged PR association for the same commit SHA in the same base repository. Commits linked only to open PRs are excluded. All commit/PR checks use the PR base repository; PRs in another repository do not affect qualification. Closed-PR commit counts come directly from recorded PR associations without requiring repository history or commit metadata; closed-PR churn requires commit metadata, so it can cover fewer commits. Each SHA is counted once per panel if any selected accessible repository qualifies. A SHA shared across repositories can therefore qualify in both categories; these totals should not be added as disjoint sets.
- **Commits/code churn without recorded PRs** have no recorded PR association of any status in a qualifying repository. This includes branches without PRs and direct-to-default-branch commits; it does not prove the commits never reached main or bypassed review. Counts depend on complete commit/PR ingestion, and historical associations may remain after branch history changes. Equivalent code can ship under another SHA (for example, through squashing or cherry-picking).
- **Reporting periods and line counts:** PRs Closed, Never Merged and the closed-PR commit/churn panels use PR closure dates; commits may have been created before the selected period. The merged-PR exclusion checks all dates. Panels without recorded PRs use commit dates and check PR associations across all dates, so their reporting periods differ from the closed-PR panels. Code churn is shown in lines (additions + deletions), counted once per SHA. Repeated edits are counted; this is not unique abandoned code.
- **PR Abandonment Rate** is the delivery-outcome view of the same problem: no field links an AI session to the branch or PR it produced, so a dollar/token cost can't be attached to abandoned work directly. This table measures it a different way instead — PR-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored) — as an outcome-based proxy for wasted effort, not an AI-cost-denominated one.

panels.description: Total AI tokens consumed, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.*_tokens)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens Burned"
FROM ai_model_usages
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Tokens Burned

panels.description: Total Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.num_sessions)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Claude Sessions

panels.description: Total active engineering hours logged by Claude Code, from OTel telemetry, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Not available at the domain layer for any provider.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ha.active_time_seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Active Hours"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity ha
WHERE ha.connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(ha.hour_start)

panels.title: Active Hours

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)

panels.title: PRs Merged

panels.description: Distinct pull requests closed without merging, scoped to the selected project(s), using PR closure dates. Closed-PR commit/churn panels use the same date field; panels without recorded PRs use commit dates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS "PRs Closed, Never Merged"
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'CLOSED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date)

panels.title: PRs Closed, Never Merged

panels.description: Distinct recorded commit SHAs in PRs closed during the selected period, scoped by PR base repository to the selected project(s), excluding SHAs associated with merged PRs in the same base repository across any date. Includes associations without commit metadata; recorded associations do not prove code was abandoned.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT prc.commit_sha) AS "Commits in Closed, Unmerged PRs"
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
JOIN project_mapping pm
  ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (
  SELECT upm_g.project_name
  FROM user_project_mapping upm_g
  WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
    AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)
)
  AND pr.status = 'CLOSED'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pull_request_commits prc2
    JOIN pull_requests merged_pr ON merged_pr.id = prc2.pull_request_id
    WHERE prc2.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha
      AND merged_pr.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
      AND merged_pr.status = 'MERGED'
  )

panels.title: Commits in Closed, Unmerged PRs

panels.description: Total code churn in lines (additions + deletions), counted once per commit in PRs closed during the selected period, scoped by PR base repository to the selected project(s), excluding merged PR associations in the same base repository across any date. Requires additions/deletions metadata from the commits table; PR commits missing that metadata are excluded, so churn may be undercounted. Repeated edits and changes shipped elsewhere are included.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sz), 0) AS "Code Churn in Closed, Unmerged PRs"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, (COALESCE(c.additions, 0) + COALESCE(c.deletions, 0)) AS sz
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  JOIN project_mapping pm
    ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (
    SELECT upm_g.project_name
    FROM user_project_mapping upm_g
    WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
      AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)
  )
    AND pr.status = 'CLOSED'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pull_request_commits prc2
      JOIN pull_requests merged_pr ON merged_pr.id = prc2.pull_request_id
      WHERE prc2.commit_sha = prc.commit_sha
        AND merged_pr.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
        AND merged_pr.status = 'MERGED'
    )
) x

panels.title: Code Churn in Closed, Unmerged PRs

panels.description: Distinct commits without recorded PR associations or merged-PR result SHAs in the same base repository, scoped to the selected project(s), using commit dates. Incomplete associations or rebased SHAs can inflate counts; this does not prove direct pushes to main.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS "Commits Without PRs"
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rc.repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id
  WHERE prc.commit_sha = c.sha AND pr.base_repo_id = rc.repo_id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM pull_requests mpr
  WHERE mpr.merge_commit_sha = c.sha
    AND mpr.base_repo_id = rc.repo_id
    AND mpr.status = 'MERGED'
)

panels.title: Commits Without PRs

panels.description: Total code churn in lines (additions + deletions), counted once per commit without recorded PR associations or merged-PR result SHAs in the same base repository, using commit dates. Incomplete associations or rebased SHAs can inflate totals; churn is not unique abandoned code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sz), 0) AS "Code Churn Without Recorded PRs" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, (COALESCE(c.additions, 0) + COALESCE(c.deletions, 0)) AS sz
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rc.repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pull_request_commits prc
    JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id
    WHERE prc.commit_sha = c.sha AND pr.base_repo_id = rc.repo_id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pull_requests mpr
    WHERE mpr.merge_commit_sha = c.sha
      AND mpr.base_repo_id = rc.repo_id
      AND mpr.status = 'MERGED'
  )
) x

panels.title: Code Churn Without Recorded PRs

panels.description: PR-level, not commit/branch-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored), scoped to the selected project(s), minimum 5 PRs authored in range to avoid noisy small-sample rates. Measures delivery outcome, not AI-specific cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name) AS "Contributor",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total PRs",
  SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') AS "Abandoned (Closed, Never Merged)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Abandonment Rate %"
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') AND COALESCE(pr.merged_date, pr.closed_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: PR Abandonment Rate by Contributor

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;
list.label: Project
list.name: project
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;
list.label: Claude Code OTel teams
list.name: otel_teams
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;
